Degree and placement of stress are usually predictable. The classification (fixed and weight-blind, initial primary stress, compound/kin-term+name exceptions as listed-set, word domain) rests on the fieldworker-of-record's grammar sketch (1978 dissertation appendix, the only grammar sketch Glottolog lists for the Wik-Ngathan/Wik-Ngatharr language) plus his own 2021 restatement that names Wik-Ngatharr explicitly ('the vowel with primary word stress' in the first syllable) and Hale's 2021 note on unstressed-vowel reduction in Wik-Ngatharr.
